name: project-launchdeck
description: Repository-owned VoyageWright Codex launches with full project/GitHub context, Project Trim contracts, standard titles, retry receipts, and safe fallback.

interface.longDescription: Launch or prepare VoyageWright tasks from regular ChatGPT Chat, Work, and Codex using each surface's exposed context, GitHub and native actions. Uses repository-owned Project Trim, standard titles, durable retry receipts, Goal evidence and owned-relay cleanup. Current package provides launch instructions and deterministic helpers, not a plugin-owned executable chat-creation tool. The required direct regular-Chat launch remains blocked on a supported native backend binding. No source continuation or executor relays.
defaultPrompt: Launch the agreed phase as a Goal in the VoyageWright Codex project using Project Trim.
Prepare a compact implementation launch from our agreed scope and current repository evidence.
Check a previous Launchdeck request and reconcile its receipt before retrying.
